meaning_hint: Indeclinable in Ukrainian.
examples: He plays rugby at his college.
Rugby is very popular in New Zealand.
We watched a rugby match on Saturday.
She broke her nose playing rugby.

meaning_hint: Often a prefix (міні-спідниця); also short for miniskirt.
examples: She wore a mini skirt to the party.
We bought a mini fridge for the dorm.
The hotel room has a mini bar.
They sell mini versions of their cakes.
note: Usually part of a compound: miniskirt, minibar, minivan.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian also uses космонавт.
examples: The astronaut spent six months in space.
She dreamed of becoming an astronaut as a child.
Astronauts train for years before a mission.
The astronaut waved from the window of the station.
Winning the cup was a great triumph for the team.
The movie was a triumph at the box office.
She returned home in triumph.
His recovery was a triumph of hope.
My teammate passed me the ball.
She thanked her teammates after the win.
We need one more teammate for the match.
He is my teammate in this online game.
Oops, I dropped my phone again.
Oops, I sent the message to the wrong person.
Oops, sorry, I didn't see you there.
She said "oops" when she spilled the coffee.
The movie is about a gangster in Chicago.
He dressed like an old-time gangster for the party.
The gangsters robbed a bank downtown.
She loves classic gangster films.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian only a music single (song release).
examples: Her new single is on the radio.
The band released a single last week.
This single went to number one.
I bought the single online.
The ship's voyage took three weeks.
They went on a voyage across the ocean.
The first voyage of the ship ended badly.
Sailors prepared for a long voyage.
Abuse at home is a serious problem.
She spoke about the abuse she suffered.
Child abuse must be reported.
He left after years of abuse.
The doctor examined her vagina during the checkup.
The baby moves through the vagina during birth.
The vagina is part of the female body.
She learned about the vagina in biology class.

meaning_hint: Only an electronic screen; a show or exhibition = показ, виставка
examples: The phone has a bright display.
The display on my watch is broken.
Shoes are on display in the window.
The new laptop has a large display.
She got a patent for her invention.
The company owns the patent for this drug.
He applied for a patent last year.
The patent protects the idea for twenty years.
I buy groceries at the supermarket.
The supermarket is open until ten.
There is a new supermarket nearby.
She works at the supermarket.

meaning_hint: Toothpaste and other soft mixtures are 'paste', not pasta.
examples: We had pasta for dinner.
I cook pasta with tomato sauce.
This pasta is fresh.
How long do you boil the pasta?

meaning_hint: British spelling: kilometre.
examples: The station is two kilometers away.
I run five kilometers every morning.
The speed limit is 50 kilometers per hour.
The lake is ten kilometers long.
A sniper was hiding on the roof.
The sniper waited for hours without moving.
Soldiers were warned about snipers in the city.
He trained as a sniper in the army.
She was a pioneer in computer science.
Pioneers moved west in wagons.
He is a pioneer of electric cars.
The pioneers built the first town here.
He's a total computer nerd.
I was a nerd in high school.
She is a proud science nerd.
The nerds in my class love chess.
note: Informal; can be friendly or rude.

meaning_hint: Pronounced like 'base': the low voice or bass guitar. The fish bass (/bæs/) = окунь.
examples: He plays bass in a rock band.
Turn down the bass, it's too loud.
She bought a new bass guitar.
The bass sounds great in this song.
She showed great enthusiasm for the project.
The kids greeted us with enthusiasm.
His enthusiasm is contagious.
I lost my enthusiasm after the meeting.
He is a true patriot who loves his country.
Patriots fought for independence.
She called herself a proud patriot.
Many patriots joined the army.
He became a millionaire before he turned thirty.
She dreams of being a millionaire one day.
The millionaire gave money to the local school.
Winning the lottery made him a millionaire.

meaning_hint: Also called a couch.
examples: We sat on the sofa and watched a movie.
The cat sleeps on the sofa all day.
They bought a new leather sofa.
You can sleep on the sofa tonight.
note: "Couch" is more common in everyday American English.

meaning_hint: Also a town with mineral springs.
examples: We spent the weekend at a spa.
The hotel spa has a pool and sauna.
She got a facial at the spa.
The town is famous for its spas.

meaning_hint: Чилі with a capital letter is the country Chile.
examples: Add a chili for extra heat.
This dish has a lot of chili.
She grows red chilies in the garden.
Be careful, the chili is very hot.

meaning_hint: Also an author's text before it is printed.
examples: She sent her manuscript to three publishers last week.
The old manuscript is kept in the library museum.
He finished the first draft of his manuscript.
The editor returned the manuscript with many notes.

meaning_hint: Mostly fake news or content; the adjective is фейковий or підроблений
examples: That bag is a fake.
The story turned out to be a fake.
Is this painting real or a fake?
He sold fakes as real watches.
The comedy duo performed on TV last night.
They are a famous pop duo.
The duo released a new song.
She sings in a duo with her sister.

meaning_hint: Capitalized in English (a Viking); lowercase in Ukrainian.
examples: The Vikings sailed across the sea.
A Viking ship was found in the mud.
The Vikings lived in Scandinavia.
He dressed as a Viking for the party.
Ask the system administrator for a new password.
She is a school administrator.
The administrator manages the website.
Contact the administrator if you have problems.

meaning_hint: Short for логотип, the more usual Ukrainian word.
examples: The company changed its logo.
The logo is printed on every shirt.
She designed a logo for the café.
I recognized the logo right away.
I ordered three beef tacos and a soda.
We have tacos every Tuesday.
This taco is too spicy for me.
The food truck sells the best fish tacos.
We ate fresh crab at the beach.
The crab walked sideways across the sand.
She ordered crab with garlic butter.
The kids caught a small crab in the water.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian only the military vehicle; a fuel or water tank is бак, резервуар.
examples: The tank moved across the field.
Soldiers rode on the tank.
Many tanks were in the parade.
The army sent tanks to the border.
They found a fragment of an old vase.
I only heard a fragment of the conversation.
A fragment of glass cut his foot.
This is a sentence fragment, not a full sentence.

meaning_hint: Usually a hair or beauty salon.
examples: She gets her hair cut at a salon.
The nail salon is next to the bakery.
He opened a beauty salon downtown.
I booked an appointment at the salon.
Bandits robbed the travelers on the road.
The old film is about a Mexican bandit.
Police caught the bandit near the border.
The bandits hid in the mountains.
note: Sounds old-fashioned; "robber" is more common today.

meaning_hint: A space shuttle, or a bus or plane making regular short trips (an airport shuttle).
examples: Take the free shuttle to the airport.
The hotel shuttle leaves every hour.
We rode the shuttle to the station.
A shuttle bus runs between buildings.
Public sentiment turned against the plan.
Market sentiment improved after the news.
I share your sentiment completely.
There is strong anti-war sentiment in the country.

meaning_hint: Any light, pleasant wind, not only by the sea.
examples: A cool breeze came from the sea.
The curtains moved in the breeze.
We enjoyed the evening breeze.
There's a nice breeze today.
The microwave made a loud beep.
Wait for the beep, then leave a message.
I heard a beep from my phone.
The car gives a beep when you lock it.

meaning_hint: A post on X/Twitter.
examples: He posted a tweet about the game.
Her tweet got many replies.
I read his tweets every day.
The tweet went viral.

meaning_hint: Mostly American and a bit formal; the everyday word is car.
examples: The automobile changed the way people live.
He works in the automobile industry.
The museum shows the first automobiles.
Automobile sales went up this year.
She reported the harassment to her boss.
The company has a strict policy on harassment.
Online harassment is a serious problem.
He was fired for sexual harassment.

meaning_hint: Also shouted to show you do not like a performance.
examples: "Boo!" he shouted from behind the door.
The crowd started to boo the referee.
She jumped when her brother said "boo."
The kids yelled "boo" on Halloween.

meaning_hint: Trading on markets or exchanges; trade in general = торгівля
examples: He works in stock trading.
Online trading is popular now.
Trading starts at nine in the morning.
She lost money in trading.
Drag the clip onto the timeline to edit it.
The project timeline is very tight.
She made a timeline of her life for class.
Let's agree on a timeline for the work.

meaning_hint: Usually a military hospital; an ordinary hospital is лікарня.
examples: She works as a nurse at the hospital.
He was in the hospital for a week.
They took him to the hospital by ambulance.
The new hospital opened last year.
note: Americans say "in the hospital"; British say "in hospital."

meaning_hint: A top (garment) or the top of a ranking (топ-10); the top part of something is верх.
examples: She wore a white top with jeans.
I bought a new top for the party.
This top is too small for me.
Her red top matches her shoes.

meaning_hint: Also an account balance (bank, phone).
examples: What is the balance on my account?
Check your balance before you pay.
The balance is due at the end of the month.
My card has a balance of fifty dollars.

meaning_hint: A member or supporter of the British Conservative Party; capitalized.
examples: The Tories won the election in Britain.
He has voted Tory all his life.
A Tory member spoke in parliament.
The Tory leader gave a speech.

meaning_hint: Only exercise and physical fitness; suitability is придатність.
examples: She works hard on her fitness.
He goes to fitness classes three times a week.
Swimming is great for your fitness.
The fitness app tracks my steps.

meaning_hint: Also the party game Мафія.
examples: The mafia controlled the city's docks.
He was arrested for working with the mafia.
The movie is about a mafia family.
Local businesses paid money to the mafia.

meaning_hint: Only the music genre; 'the blues' (sadness) is смуток.
examples: He plays the blues on his guitar.
The blues started in the American South.
We listened to the blues all night.
She sings the blues at a small club.
The movie is about a mutant with special powers.
Scientists bred a mutant of the fruit fly.
The mutant gene causes the disease.
Mutants in comics often hide their powers.
My broker bought shares for me.
She works as an insurance broker.
The broker charged a small fee.
Ask a broker before you buy stock.
He helped a stranger for good karma.
She believes in karma and treats everyone kindly.
Losing his wallet felt like bad karma.
Karma will catch up with him one day.

meaning_hint: A coach; trainers (shoes, UK) are кросівки.
examples: My personal trainer makes me run every morning.
The gym hired a new fitness trainer.
Ask your trainer to show you the right technique.
The dog trainer taught our puppy to sit.
note: For a sports team, "coach" is more common in American English.
